d: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh says tackling inflation remains a top priority, declaring that the central bank will deliver price stability “no ifs, ands, or buts.” Speaking at a press conference, Warsh acknowledged that inflation remains above the Fed’s 2% target, with rising energy prices adding to the challenge. He defended the Fed’s approach, saying policymakers are assessing incoming economic data before determining their next steps on interest rates.
